name: Taming the Beast
summary: This quest marks the final trial in a dwarven hunter's basic training under Grif Wildheart in Kharanos. By using an enchanted rod to subdue and understand an aggressive Ice Claw Bear, the hunter demonstrates mastery over sheer brute strength. Completing this exercise unlocks the foundational abilities needed to tame, call, and dismiss a permanent wild companion.

sections.title: The Strength of the Wild
sections.body: Throughout Dun Morogh, mountaineers and scouts have long relied on hardy beasts to endure the freezing crags. After directing his students to practice on swift and cunning predators, master huntsman Grif Wildheart tasks budding hunters with capturing an Ice Claw Bear. Found prowling the snowdrifts east of Kharanos, these massive beasts embody raw physical power and relentless endurance—qualities every dwarven huntsman must learn to control.

sections.title: Earning a Companion
sections.body: The trials with the Taming Rod are strictly educational exercises meant to teach hunters how wild instincts respond to will and calm intent. Once the rod holds the bear docile, the temporary bond fulfills its purpose. Returning the tool to Grif concludes the formal trials, prompting the master to share the permanent secrets of beast mastery: how to pacify any compatible wild creature and call upon it throughout a lifetime of adventure.

faq.q: What animal do I need to tame for this quest?
faq.answer: You must seek out an Ice Claw Bear, which prowls the frozen foothills east of Kharanos in Dun Morogh. Using the provided Taming Rod subdues the creature so you can experience handling raw brute force.

faq.q: Do I keep the Ice Claw Bear after turning in the quest?
faq.answer: No. The bear subdued by the Taming Rod is only a temporary test of discipline and skill. Once you hand the rod back to Grif Wildheart, the beast departs, and you are granted the true abilities to tame any wild beast you choose.
Grif Wildheart is stationed outside the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos, Dun Morogh, where he trains fledgling hunters in the ways of marksmanship and beast mastery.

faq.q: What abilities do I learn upon finishing this trial?
faq.answer: Completing this final trial teaches you the foundational spells of a hunter: Tame Beast, Call Pet, and Dismiss Pet. This allows you to venture out into the world and bond with a permanent companion.

faq.q: What is the next step after completing this quest?
faq.answer: Grif will send you onward with the quest 'Training the Beast', directing you to learn how to feed, nurture, and instruct your new companion properly so it stays loyal in combat.

faq.q: Why does Grif have hunters test multiple types of beasts?
faq.answer: The three trials expose a novice hunter to different fighting styles—agility, cunning, and brute power. Experiencing these distinct temperaments prepares a mountaineer to choose the best companion for their hunting style.

angles.text: This quest is the rite of passage that turns an isolated archer into a true pet-taming hunter, unlocking the essential abilities to tame and summon beasts.
Bears have long served as iconic companions for dwarven mountaineers patrolling Dun Morogh, renowned for matching their masters in stubborn resilience.
